query: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM businesses.esign_consent c JOIN businesses.team_member m ON m.id = c.member_id AND m.business_id = c.business_id JOIN businesses.staff_phone p ON p.id = c.line_id AND p.business_id = c.business_id WHERE c.business_id = $1 AND c.line_id = $2 AND c.channel = 'text' AND m.removed_at IS NULL) AS "yes!"
